channel.title: Cleveland Free Times - Article Feed
channel.description: Latest articles from Cleveland Free Times (freetimes.com)

item.title: Peggy Flanagan Faces Apology Demand Over Viral Hijab Video in Minnesota Senate Race
item.description: Minnesota Lt. Gov. Peggy Flanagan, Democratic Senate candidate, faces calls to apologize after a viral video of her wearing a hijab was labeled pandering by her opponent. The controversy raises questions about its impact on her Senate bid.

item.title: Swiss Ski Resort Explosion Kills Around 40 and Injures 100 on New Year’s Eve
item.description: An explosion and fire at Le Constellation bar in Crans-Montana, Switzerland, during New Year’s Eve celebrations has killed approximately 40 people and injured 100. Authorities say the incident appears accidental and investigations are ongoing.

item.title: Scott Adams Shares Grim Prostate Cancer Prognosis; 'Dilbert' Creator Faces Transition
item.description: Scott Adams, creator of 'Dilbert,' reveals his chances of recovering from advanced prostate cancer are 'essentially zero.' He outlines a 'month of transition' ahead and continues to update fans on his health journey.

item.title: US Captures Venezuelan President Maduro in Military Strike, Charges Him with Drug Offenses
item.description: The US military captured Venezuelan President Nicolás Maduro and his wife during strikes in Venezuela. They are indicted on drug charges and en route to New York, as announced by Donald Trump.

item.title: Danish PM Warns US Against Military Action on Greenland, Citing NATO Risks
item.description: Denmark's Prime Minister Mette Frederiksen cautions that any US military intervention to annex Greenland would end 80 years of NATO security cooperation, amid President Trump's renewed interest in the Arctic territory's rare earth minerals.

item.title: Steny Hoyer Announces Retirement from Congress After Four Decades
item.description: Longtime Maryland Rep. Steny Hoyer, former House majority leader, announces retirement after serving since 1981. His decision opens a competitive race in a deep-blue district.

item.title: ‘ICE Out For Good’ Vigils and Protests Erupt Nationwide After Fatal Immigration Agent Shootings
item.description: Hundreds of 'ICE Out For Good' vigils and protests are planned nationwide following deadly shootings involving ICE and Border Patrol agents in Minneapolis and Portland, sparking outrage and calls for accountability.

item.title: Ex-Iceland President Warns of Geopolitical Fallout Amid U.S. Greenland Rhetoric
item.description: Former Icelandic President Olafur Grimsson warns of unprecedented consequences if the U.S. attempts to seize Greenland, highlighting rising tensions in Arctic geopolitics.

item.title: Norwegian Officials React to María Corina Machado's Presentation of Nobel Medal to Donald Trump
item.description: Venezuelan opposition leader María Corina Machado’s decision to give her Nobel Peace Prize medal to President Trump has sparked disbelief and criticism in Norway, raising concerns over the award's integrity.

item.title: Judge Allows Operation Metro Surge to Proceed Amid Minnesota Protests
item.description: Federal judge declines to halt Operation Metro Surge in Minnesota despite concerns over racial profiling and community impact. Protests are planned nationwide this Saturday.
